chunks: I heard him say: Whoever performs tawaf around the House and mistakenly continues until he enters the eighth, then he should complete fourteen circuits, then perform two rak'ahs.
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: What this report contains, and the report before it, in his statement 'he performs two rak'ahs,' does not contradict what he narrated.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةَ عَشَرَ شَوْطًا: fourteen total circuits to be completed
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two units of salat (prayer) performed after tawaf
key_terms.فَوَهِمَ: made an error or became mistaken in counting

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they mistakenly perform an eighth circuit in tawaf?
ai.summary: This report addresses a ruling concerning tawaf when a person mistakenly adds an extra circuit and reaches the eighth round. It instructs completing fourteen circuits and then performing two rak'ahs, and the compiler notes that this wording does not conflict with another transmitted report.
